info.title: Cloud-Native Incident & Release Management API
info.description: A versioned, Level 3 RESTful Web API implementing HATEOAS (HAL + RFC 8288 Link headers), RFC 9457 Problem Details, RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch, HTTP caching (ETag / Last-Modified / 304 / 412), content negotiation (HAL+JSON, JSON, XML), and stateless HTTP Basic Authentication.

Cache-Control.description: HTTP caching directive for client and proxy caches.

Content-Security-Policy.description: Strict Content-Security-Policy header enforced on all API responses.

Link.description: RFC 8288 Web Linking header containing IANA link relations.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for conditional GET (304) and optimistic locking (412).

Vary.description: Indicates headers that influence content negotiation and representation.

304.description: Not Modified - Resource representation has not changed since ETag / Last-Modified (headers: ETag, Cache-Control, CSP).

405.description: Method Not Allowed - HTTP method not supported by this resource; includes Allow header (RFC 9457 Problem Details).

406.description: Not Acceptable - Requested Accept media type is not supported (RFC 9457 Problem Details).

422.description: Unprocessable Content - Domain or schema validation failure (RFC 9457 Problem Details).
